question:
(i) Obtain the expression for electric field at a point on the equatorial line of a short electric dipole.
(ii) Compare its direction with the direction of electric dipole moment.

options.A:
(i) $E_{\text{equatorial}}=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{2p}{r^3}$
(ii) It is along the dipole moment
options.B:
(i) $E_{\text{equatorial}}=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{p}{r^2}$
(ii) It is perpendicular to the dipole moment
options.C:
(i) $E_{\text{equatorial}}=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{2p}{r^2}$
(ii) It is opposite to the dipole moment
options.D:
(i) $E_{\text{equatorial}}=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{p}{r^3}$
(ii) It is opposite to the direction of the electric dipole moment
